<p class="page-deck">Programmes, research lines, bounded projects, studies, papers and tools—without requiring every output to have an invented parent project.</p>

The status and relationship labels distinguish current CCLL work, work begun before CCLL and continuing, completed foundational work, and associated collaborations. Research ideas are shown separately on theme pages and are not counted here.

```{=html}
<form class="work-filters" data-work-filters aria-label="Filter research work">
  <label>Keyword <input type="search" name="query" autocomplete="off"></label>
  <label>Status <select name="status"><option value="">Ongoing and completed</option><option value="ongoing">Ongoing</option><option value="completed">Completed</option></select></label>
  <label>Work type <select name="type"><option value="">All work types</option><option value="research-programme">Programme</option><option value="research-line">Research line</option><option value="project">Project</option><option value="study">Study</option><option value="paper">Paper</option><option value="report">Report</option><option value="tool">Tool</option><option value="dataset">Dataset</option></select></label>
  <label>Theme <select name="theme"><option value="">All themes</option><option value="geographies-of-climate-learning">Geographies of Climate Learning</option><option value="where-new-evidence-matters">Where New Evidence Matters</option><option value="modes-of-climate-delivery">Modes of Climate Delivery</option><option value="consequences-for-people-and-places">Consequences for People and Places</option></select></label>
  <label>Geography <input type="search" name="geography" placeholder="e.g. Canada"></label>
  <label>Method <input type="search" name="method" placeholder="e.g. comparative"></label>
  <label>Sector <input type="search" name="sector" placeholder="e.g. transport"></label>
  <button type="reset">Clear</button><output data-work-count aria-live="polite"></output>
</form>
```
